entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Yeah, hi. I need to return a helmet. Just need to know if I can.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Isaac. I can definitely help you with that. Can I just get your order number to start?
It's 884-312B. Look, I don't have a lot of time. Is this going to be a yes or a no?
I understand completely. Let me just pull that up for you... Okay, I see the Trail Helmet here, delivered 82 days ago. Is that correct?
Sounds right. The box is unopened. The color was wrong. So, can I send it back?
Yes, absolutely. According to our policy, you're well within the 90-day return window for this helmet. I can approve that for you right now.
Finally. Okay, what do I need to do?

I've just processed the return authorization. You'll get an email with a prepaid shipping label in the next few minutes. Just print it out and attach it to the box. We want to make sure you have gear you love, especially for something as critical as safety.
Got it. A shipping label. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
